title: Allegeas
summary: ALLE'GEAS, or ALLE'GIAS, noun A stuff manufactured in the East Indies, of two kinds, one of cotton, the other of various plants which are spun like flax.

inlines.v: ALLE'GEAS, or ALLE'GIAS, noun A stuff manufactured in the East Indies, of two kinds, one of cotton, the other of various plants which are spun like flax.
